raw_bound_and_dt.provenance_uncertainty: Native raw stability bounds are read from SHA-256-bound runtime summary fields, not independently recalculated via a solver/native-kernel call; exact equality and each requested/accepted dt relation are checked here.

all_differences.baseline: Short reversible native engineering diagnostic; source is frozen but solver has not been run.
all_differences.dt_half: Single-variable dt/2 companion to the completed h0600/delta1800 baseline; only the requested native-bound fraction changes, and this case remains source-only pending review.

raw_stored_full_velocity_kinetic_energy_.interpretation: This reproduces the native raw all-point 0.5*m*|V_full|^2 diagnostic. The grip-mask contribution is separately exposed because native velocity BC constrains vhalf; subsequent full V includes the post-force acceleration half-step. These components do not establish physical kinetic energy at constrained points.

uncertainties: Native raw stability bound values are producer-recorded in the hash-bound summary; this reviewer compares them exactly and checks the accepted/requested dt arithmetic without re-running the solver or native stability routine.

The native velocity boundary condition constrains vhalf; after force evaluation, stored full V includes a_n*dt/2. Fixed grip positions therefore do not imply zero stored full-step grip velocity. The all-point 0.5*m*|V_full|^2 recomputation is the correct raw solver diagnostic, but physical kinetic energy at constrained grips remains UNKNOWN; free-DOF and grip-masked raw contributions are reported separately.
This failure-disabled, uncalibrated NoCorrection OSB comparison cannot establish time-step convergence, material calibration, fracture behavior, or real-object physics.
Any lower residual or smaller dt/2 difference is descriptive sensitivity evidence only, not a scientific pass criterion.
